statement: The Quest operator surface is safer and simpler: structured failures expose stable automation repair codes, record-attempt replaces the ambiguous commit-step label while legacy actions remain accepted, scope decisions charge only the current net source candidate and suggest deterministic splits without automatic closure, friction reports distinguish operator stops from advisories, and publish verifies and pushes one exact committed HEAD without staging, committing, amending, force-pushing, or sweeping unrelated work.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
